snippet.title: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut - PC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863680/ZERO_PARADES/

ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut is now available across PC storefronts! 

This is a FREE update for all owners of ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies, bringing more material, revisions and improvements to our espionage RPG. 

Experience a brand new Dramatic Encounter, step into Backstage mode to see the making-of and explore, see and hear more of Portofiro. 

This definitive edition of ZERO PARADES comes to PlayStation®5 (PS5®) on November 3rd.
